rows.label: America's Got Talent
rows.hook: lets singers, magicians and dog acts audition for a celebrity panel and a golden buzzer

rows.label: Survivor
rows.description: American version of the international Survivor reality competition television franchise
rows.hook: strands contestants on a remote island where tribes compete and vote each other out with torches snuffed

rows.label: Hell's Kitchen
rows.hook: has a fiery, foul-mouthed celebrity chef yelling at aspiring cooks competing to run a restaurant

rows.label: Jackass
rows.hook: features a crew performing painful, dangerous stunts and pranks on themselves for laughs

rows.label: Impractical Jokers
rows.hook: follows four friends who dare each other to do embarrassing public challenges through hidden earpieces

rows.label: Jersey Shore
rows.hook: follows a group of tanned housemates in a beach town known for gym, tanning and laundry

rows.label: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
rows.hook: features a hot-tempered British chef trying to rescue failing restaurants across the country

rows.label: The Masked Singer
rows.description: 2019 American reality singing competition television game show
rows.hook: has celebrities sing in elaborate full-body costumes while a panel guesses who is underneath

rows.label: MasterChef USA
rows.hook: has home cooks compete for a title and cookbook deal, judged by a trio including a famously fiery chef

rows.label: Pawn Stars
rows.hook: follows a family-run Las Vegas shop where customers try to sell rare and unusual items

rows.label: Shark Tank
rows.hook: has entrepreneurs pitch their inventions to wealthy investors hoping to land a deal

rows.label: The X Factor
rows.hook: was a singing contest created by a music mogul known for a scathing judging panel

rows.label: Running Man
rows.hook: has celebrity cast members race through city landmarks completing games and ripping name tags off each other

rows.label: Deadliest Catch
rows.description: reality television series, Discovery Channel, 2005 — present
rows.hook: follows crab fishermen braving dangerous waves in the Bering Sea

rows.label: The Amazing Race
rows.hook: sends teams of two racing around the globe completing tasks and roadblocks to win a million dollars

rows.label: Britain's Got Talent
rows.hook: has singers, dancers and novelty acts audition for celebrity judges, hoping to reach a live final

rows.label: MasterChef Australia
rows.description: Australian reality competitive cooking game show based on the original British MasterChef
rows.hook: has amateur cooks face pressure tests and mystery boxes to win a trophy from the land down under

rows.label: Storage Wars
rows.hook: follows buyers who bid on the contents of abandoned lockers hoping to find valuable treasures

rows.label: Dance Moms
rows.hook: follows young dancers and their intense coach and stage mothers in a Pittsburgh studio

rows.label: Keeping Up with the Kardashians
rows.hook: follows a famous California family with a momager and sisters whose names all start with K

rows.label: The Bachelor
rows.description: American reality television series on ABC
rows.hook: has a single suitor hand out roses each week to narrow down a group of romantic hopefuls

rows.label: America's Next Top Model
rows.hook: has aspiring models compete in photo shoots and runway challenges, hosted by a famous supermodel

rows.label: Top Chef
rows.hook: has cooks tackle quickfire and elimination challenges, with losers told to pack their knives

rows.label: So You Think You Can Dance
rows.description: American reality television dance competition show
rows.hook: has dancers of every style compete for America's votes to win a cash prize

rows.label: The Ultimate Fighter
rows.description: American reality series and MMA competition
rows.hook: puts rival teams of aspiring cage fighters in a house to earn a professional contract
